origin: Authored from scratch for mapcro. Not imported from any earlier artifact.
sources_read: concierge/artifacts/deadlock-coach/README.md, index.html, style.css (prototype; read for context only, nothing copied)
game_assets: None in committed files. Pages link ../_art/art.css, which is generated from the operator's local Deadlock install (build 6860) into design/_art/ (git-ignored, see design/_art/manifest.json). Without it the canvas drops the link and every page falls back to the original schematic map, glyphs and initial tokens.
network: None. Pages use board.css, tweaks.css, the self-hosted fonts in design/fonts/ and the optional ../_art/art.css, all local.
generator: Written by a scratch Python generator outside the repo. The HTML here is the source of truth; edit it directly.
derived_data: Objective positions and the schematic lane lines are placed from the map's entity origins through deadlock-api's transform (R=10752). Only coordinates are committed, never art.

fonts.choice: Federo (display: clocks, titles, wordmark) for its art-deco signage character; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (UI) for legibility at small sizes. Both SIL OFL 1.1.
fonts.conversion: Lossless TTF to WOFF2 with woff2_compress (nixpkgs#woff2). No subsetting or glyph changes.
